## Feedback
Describe the user's words or observation accurately. Remove identifying and sensitive details unless necessary and explicitly authorized.

## Current experience
What did the person try? What happened? What did they expect? Include reproducible terminal steps where available.

## Impact

Describe a possible change without presenting it as approved work. Link an issue or feature proposal if one is created.
